attendance-grid.tsx line 538-551: rank function returns 0 for exact code/bio match, 1 for name/code prefix, 2 otherwise. Array.prototype.sort with equal ranks preserves original alpha order (stable sort in V8). Result: '212' → 1 exact hit ranks first, verified.

attendance-grid.tsx line 899-913: clear button visibility gated on qInput.length>0 (raw input, not debounced), so it appears instantly when user starts typing — good UX. 'N found' count uses debounced q so it only shows after the filter has applied.
attendance-grid.tsx line 901: onPress of clear does both setQInput('') and setQ('') — bypasses the 200ms debounce so full list restores immediately. Correct.
